sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Healthcare and Consumer Defensive post the only all-green profiles across all timeframes, while Communication Services languishes at the bottom.

Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are leading the market, representing the only 2 of 11 sectors that are positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and year-to-date. Healthcare exhibits the most sustained strength, holding a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows alongside a market-leading momentum score of 0.883. Energy also maintains strong year-to-date leadership at rank 1 with 0.767 momentum.

Rotation remains tight, with minor 5-session gains in Industrials (+1 spot to rank 5) and Real Estate (+1 spot to rank 7). Conversely, Basic Materials and Financials are fading, each slipping 1 spot over the last 5 sessions to ranks 6 and 8, respectively. Bottom-tier momentum is firmly anchored by Communication Services at 0.000 (rank 11) and Consumer Cyclical at 0.383 (rank 10).

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 groups—Healthcare (0.88 momentum) and Consumer Defensive (0.80 momentum)—remain positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD.
- **Sustained leadership:** Healthcare is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, maintaining a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top momentum scores:** Healthcare leads all sectors with a 0.883 momentum score (YTD rank 3), followed by Consumer Defensive at 0.800 (YTD rank 4) and Energy at 0.767 (YTD rank 1).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-session gainers:** Industrials advanced +1 spot to reach rank 5 (momentum 0.400), while Real Estate moved up +1 spot to rank 7 (momentum 0.533).
- **Top 5-session decliners:** Basic Materials fell -1 spot to rank 6 (momentum 0.317), and Financials dropped -1 spot to rank 8 despite a moderate momentum score of 0.550.
- **Lagging momentum:** Communication Services sits at the bottom with a 0.000 momentum score (rank 11), joined by Basic Materials (0.317), Consumer Cyclical (0.383), and Utilities (0.400).

## Divergences
- **Technology momentum lag:** Technology holds the #2 YTD rank, but its momentum score has softened to 0.470, sitting below lower-ranked sectors like Financials (0.550) and Real Estate (0.533).
- **Financial rank mismatch:** Financials slipped to rank 8 over the past 5 sessions despite carrying a top-half momentum score of 0.550.
- **No fragile all-green alerts:** The computed early-warning divergence signals show no valid unstable all-green sectors.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Travel, lodging, and defensive consumer staples dominate sustained leadership, while precious metals, mining, and tech content face sharp five-session drawdowns.

Market breadth remains selective, with 27 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles across all tracked time horizons (week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD). Leadership is anchored by hospitality and consumer staples, as Lodging (momentum 0.904), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.869), Drug Manufacturers - General (0.886), and Tobacco (0.819) demonstrate persistent strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes. Concurrently, Textile Manufacturing has staged a massive surge, gaining 130 spots over the last five sessions to capture the top momentum score across all groups (0.930, rank 11).

Rotation is punishing commodities and digital media. Metals and agricultural groups experienced severe short-term deteriorations, led by Farm Products (-33 spots to rank 78), Silver (-31 spots to rank 97), Other Industrial Metals & Mining (-28 spots to rank 72), and Gold (-25 spots to rank 113). Concurrently, digital tech and media remain deeply depressed, with Internet Content & Information slipping 27 spots to rank 118 with an anemic momentum score of 0.119, joined at the bottom by Uranium (0.015) and Advertising Agencies (0.066).

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 27 of 144 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD windows, led by Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.93), Lodging (0.90), Drug Manufacturers - General (0.89), and REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.87).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Core defensive and travel groups remain anchored in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks, including Tobacco, Beverages - Non-Alcoholic, Insurance - Diversified, and Credit Services.
- **High-Momentum Defensives:** Insurance - Reinsurance (0.81), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.78), and Medical Distribution (0.78) continue to post elite momentum metrics within the all-green cohort.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Short-Term Gainers:** Textile Manufacturing leaped +130 spots over 5 sessions to rank 11, followed by Engineering & Construction (+26 spots to rank 45) and Luxury Goods (+19 spots to rank 93).
- **Steepest 5-Day Declines:** Farm Products tumbled -33 spots to rank 78 (momentum 0.24), Silver dropped -31 spots to rank 97 (momentum 0.22), and Other Industrial Metals & Mining shed -28 spots to rank 72 (momentum 0.25).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Uranium (0.015, rank 138), Advertising Agencies (0.066, rank 144), and Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.073, rank 139) represent the weakest absolute momentum profiles in the market.

## Divergences
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Engineering & Construction (+26 spots, momentum 0.42), Luxury Goods (+19 spots, momentum 0.50), and Residential Construction (+10 spots, momentum 0.49) show rapid short-term rank acceleration despite lagging overall momentum scores.
- **Fading Momentum:** Consumer Electronics has dropped -12 spots over the past 5 sessions despite a 0.61 momentum score; Diagnostics & Research slipped -3 spots despite strong 0.74 momentum.
- **Health & Staples Stalls:** Healthcare Plans (-5 spots, momentum 0.64) and Household & Personal Products (-1 spot, momentum 0.66) are showing early signs of rank fatigue against historically solid momentum backdrops.
